description: WiFi connection. Tries known networks in order; when the master isn't reachable it can start its own hotspot serving the logger's web page (status, network settings, and recording controls while the master isn't connected).

networks.description: Tried in order, e.g. the master's network first, then a bench network.

hotspot.description: When to run the logger's own hotspot. no_master: while not connected to the master (after a 20 s grace), so a logger on the master's network but out of its reach can still be reached; no_network: only while no known network is joined.

enabled.description: Turn WiFi off entirely to save battery.

trying.description: Network being looked for, while not joined.

hotspot.description: The hotspot's name, while it's on.

off_until_restart.description: WiFi was switched off (off_until_restart, or auto_off_after_s while recording); it comes back at the next power-on.

master_search.description: Present when recording was started from the logger's own page: it no longer looks for the master until the next power-on.

off_until_restart.description: Turn WiFi off completely (no hotspot, no looking for the master) to save battery, e.g. after starting a recording in the field. Not stored: switching the logger off and on brings WiFi back as configured. Also a button on the logger's page.

events.wifi_off: WiFi is switching off until the next power-on: off_until_restart, or by itself while recording once the hotspot is unused (detail.reason).
